neighbours.label: the opening quotation mark that starts direct speech after said/asked/told in a narrative; indirect speech and scare quotes stay quiet
fire: I walked over to the woman at the counter and showed her my form. "Well," she said, "this looks fine." Then she said, "Sign at the bottom."
The priest found them weeping and he said to them: “Do not be afraid.” She asked him: “Who sent you to this town?”
My agent took the script to the studio and said, “You should read this one.” The producer rang me and said, “We want to meet.”
The actor met my brother backstage, and he told him, “You look exactly like your father.” My brother laughed and said, “Everyone says so.”
Grandpa looked at the broken window and asked, ‘Who did this?’ Nobody moved, so he said, ‘Then nobody gets dessert.’
We got to the gate late and the guard stopped us. He said, "You can't park here." I said, "We are only staying a minute."
The doctor read the chart and turned to me and said, “It could be worse.” I asked her, “How long will it take?”
The man with no shoes began singing in the street. A boy asked him "Why are you so cheerful?" He answered "Because it is spring."
quiet: I walked over to the woman at the counter and showed her my form. She said that it looked fine, and then she told me to sign at the bottom.
The priest found them weeping and he told them not to be afraid. She asked him who had sent him to this town.
My agent took the script to the studio and said I should wait. The producer rang me later and said that they wanted to meet.
The actor met my brother backstage, and he told him that he looked exactly like his father. My brother laughed about it.
Grandpa looked at the broken window and asked who had done it. Nobody moved, so he said that nobody would get dessert.
We got to the gate late and the guard stopped us. The sign said "No Parking" and the "visitor" lot was full.
The doctor read the chart titled “Recovery Notes” and turned to me. She told me that the “standard” treatment would take a month.
The man with no shoes began singing “Amazing Grace” in the street. A boy asked him why he was so cheerful, and he said it was spring.

notes: Probes: short one-line items scored at most 0.16; several sentences of narrative before the quote scored 0.33-0.80, so the test uses longer passages.
